decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggressive plays by using low-cost creatures like Vein Ripper and Bloodtithe Harvester to pressure opponents early on. With removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, it aims to control the board while utilizing powerful creatures like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse for additional threats. The inclusion of Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord helps buff up creatures and provide lifelink. The deck also includes hand disruption with cards like Duress and utilizes lands like Mutavault and Hive of the Eye Tyrant for added versatility in combat.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively play out powerful spirit creatures while maintaining tempo with disruptive spells like Spell Pierce. Ascendant Spirit and Supreme Phantom boost the power of the spirits, while Curious Obsession helps draw extra cards. Faceless Haven provides a snow-covered land for potential snow synergies, and Geistlight Snare can tap down opposing threats. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and efficient spirit-focused game plan.

The deck revolves around utilizing Lotus Field to generate a large amount of mana quickly in order to cast powerful spells and combo off. It includes cards like Thespian's Stage, Hidden Strings, and Pore Over the Pages to help ramp and draw cards, while also running cards like Emergent Ultimatum and Fae of Wishes to search for win conditions. The deck also includes control elements like Strict Proctor and Archdruid's Charm to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The goal is to set up a board state where you can overwhelm your opponent with powerful spells and win the game quickly.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to quickly take control of the game and apply pressure to the opponent. By combining efficient removal like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize with powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while steadily building up its own board presence. With a mix of creatures, spells, and lands that enable both aggression and card advantage, this Rakdos Aggro deck is designed to keep the pressure on the opponent and secure a swift victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with instant and sorcery cards to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. Ledger Shredder helps facilitate this by milling cards, while spells like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse can also be used to trigger the Phoenix's ability. The deck also includes card draw spells like Treasure Cruise and Consider to help dig for the Phoenix. Hall of Storm Giants and Otawara, Soaring City provide additional win conditions, while Spell Pierce helps protect key spells. Overall, the deck aims to be fast and aggressive with a strong graveyard synergy.

The main focus of this deck is to cast spells quickly and efficiently to trigger the ability of Arclight Phoenix, allowing it to be brought back from the graveyard multiple times in a single turn. The deck is designed to be aggressive, utilizing cheap spells like Fiery Impulse and Picklock Prankster to control the board and maintain pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of Treasure Cruise and Ledger Shredder helps to refill the hand and keep the pressure up, while cards like Hall of Storm Giants and Otawara, Soaring City provide additional threats to close out the game.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures and burn spells. With a focus on dealing damage quickly, the deck aims to control the board and put pressure on the opponent, while also utilizing burn spells to finish off the opponent or deal with troublesome creatures. The inclusion of cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage synergize well with burn spells like Lightning Helix and Boros Charm, allowing for efficient removal and direct damage. The deck's mixture of aggressive creatures and burn spells creates a versatile and powerful strategy.

The main idea of the deck is to use Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Ob Nixilis, the Adversary. The deck also utilizes cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Torch the Tower. Additionally, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can provide card advantage and Case of the Stashed Skeleton can help recur key creatures. Jegantha, the Wellspring is included as a companion to provide additional mana ramp and utility.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By utilizing low-cost creatures like Dusk Legion Zealot and Vein Ripper, as well as efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to control the board and deal damage rapidly. Key cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger provide additional value and finishing power. The inclusion of cards like Bitter Triumph and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker add consistency and resilience to the strategy, making it a potent force in the Pioneer format.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix multiple times, overwhelming the opponent with aggressive plays. The deck includes cards like Consider, Opt, and Sleight of Hand to help dig through the deck and find key pieces, while also including removal spells like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse to control the board. The inclusion of cards like Ledger Shredder and Hall of Storm Giants also provide additional ways to fuel the Phoenix's return. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain a strong presence on the battlefield.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive creature plays combined with burn spells to deal damage to the opponent as quickly as possible. By utilizing efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Burning-Tree Emissary, along with burn spells like Play with Fire and Atarka's Command, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early in the game. With a mix of creatures and direct damage spells, this deck is designed to apply constant pressure and finish off the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.

The key concept of the deck is to assemble a powerful combo utilizing Amalia Benavides Aguirre as the centerpiece. The deck focuses on generating life gain and mana ramp through cards like Wildgrowth Walker and Prosperous Innkeeper, while utilizing cards like Fauna Shaman and Chord of Calling to search for key pieces like Extraction Specialist and Aetherflux Reservoir. Collected Company and Concealed Courtyard provide additional support for the combo, allowing for efficient card draw and creature searches. Ultimately, the goal is to create a formidable board presence and win condition using a synergistic combination of cards.

The main theme of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand and resources while generating card advantage and value through cards like Duress, Thoughtseize, and Liliana of the Veil. It aims to control the game by removing threats with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, while also utilizing cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Reckoner Bankbuster to maintain board control. The deck also includes a few finishers like Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal and Hostile Investigator to close out the game once the opponent's resources are depleted.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with a combination of efficient removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful creatures. The key strategy is to control the board early with cards like Fatal Push and Thoughseize while applying pressure with Bloodtithe Harvester and Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord. The deck also utilizes cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to grind out value in longer games. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while quickly closing out games with a mix of creatures and spells.

This deck focuses on generating life gain and creature tokens through the combination of Amalia Benavides Aguirre and various support cards like Prosperous Innkeeper and Wildgrowth Walker. The goal is to build up a large life total and board presence to enable a game-winning play with Aetherflux Reservoir. The deck also includes cards like Chord of Calling and Collected Company to search for key combo pieces and maintain pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of removal options like Skyclave Apparition and extraction effects rounds out the strategy.

This deck focuses on generating life gain and utilizing creature combos to create a powerful board presence. Key cards like Amalia Benavides Aguirre, Prosperous Innkeeper, and Wildgrowth Walker help gain life and generate value. Chord of Calling and Collected Company allow for tutoring and searching for key combo pieces. The deck also includes cards like Aetherflux Reservoir for alternate win conditions. By efficiently gaining life and assembling the right combinations of creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure victory.
